subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Which WhatsApp call statuses, recipients, retention period, and agent-facing surface are acceptable for opt-in call-activity tracking?
rationale: The Baileys event can be subscribed to mechanically, but deciding whether sensitive call metadata reaches agents, is stored, or is exposed as hooks/tool data is a product and privacy boundary rather than a code-only choice.

options.title: Opt-in sanitized activity hook
options.body: Expose only selected call lifecycle events through a documented WhatsApp plugin hook after account and privacy filtering, leaving storage to the consuming plugin.

options.title: Opt-in contact-history feature
options.body: Persist a narrowly defined last-contact activity record with an explicit retention policy and a user-facing query surface.

options.title: Do not expose call activity
options.body: Keep the existing message-only inbound contract and retain outbound MeowCaller calls as the only supported WhatsApp calling feature.

recommendation.title: Opt-in sanitized activity hook
recommendation.body: Expose only selected call lifecycle events through a documented WhatsApp plugin hook after account and privacy filtering, leaving storage to the consuming plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and adjacent merged WhatsApp call work place the relevant plugin and product-boundary history with this contributor.
